Songs of the Warlpiri people in Yuendumu, Australia, convey information about wild edible seeds, and the songs of the Sakha people in Siberia, Russia, address the effects of climate change on local ecosystems. There have been efforts made to preserve Indigenous languages over the years—e.g., the United Nations' International Decade of Indigenous Languages (2022-2032).
